reviewMethod: Existing-chat consultation, saved execution history and local artifact/code comparison; no new Azure or evaluation-model calls.
reviewTracks: modular ingestion and successful account recovery
C1/M1 cost, lifecycle and provider binding

limits: Per-invocation executable hashes were not captured.
The outer CLI-selected ARM HTTP API version and staged update wire request were not retained.
Matching tooling does not establish the backend failure cause.

findings.finding: Inherited canary identity/policy matching did not establish current health; eight uploads preceded a fresh chunk health check.
findings.action: Require fresh owned real-chunk write/read/scoped/vector/hybrid health evidence before full-corpus ingestion, including reused containers.

findings.finding: Worker settings were verified, but the mounted workflow package and parameters were not independently reopened as in M1.
findings.action: Rebind actual mounted package and parameters before ingestion resumes.

findings.finding: Normal scope cleanup assumed all sources ready; failure recovery needed a separately reviewed tool.
findings.action: Predeclare partial-ingestion cleanup, quiescence evidence and stop-on-unknown rules before another upload batch.

findings.finding: The existing chunkWriteChargeKnown meter includes collision-verification reads.
findings.action: Label 28450.86 RU an instrumented chunk-store subtotal and separate observed broker redelivery from unknown provider retries.

findings.finding: The bound historical README names the preparatory agent directory rather than the coordinator execution directory.
findings.action: Preserve the hashed README and provide a corrected private restart note; do not reuse consumed mutation ledgers.

decision: No established deployment-tool/configuration cause. Keep the benchmark frozen; enforce the new preparation prerequisites before any restart. No cloud retry, architecture change or ranking recommendation follows from this review.
